name: 02 - UX Engineer v2 - With Conversation History

nodes.name: UX Chat Input
nodes.notes:
📝 UX CHAT INTERFACE Receives design iteration requests. POST /webhook/ux-chat Body: { "message": "Make the button blue", "chat_id": "optional-uuid", "current_html": "
...
" }

nodes.name: PM Requirements Input
nodes.notes:
🎯 PRODUCT MANAGER INPUT

Receives new design requirements.

POST /webhook/pm-to-ux
Body: {
  "story_id": "STORY-123",
  "requirements": "Create login form...",
  "acceptance_criteria": [...]
}

nodes.name: Build Context
nodes.notes:
🏗️ CONTEXT BUILDER

Normalizes input data.
Generates chat_id if not provided.

nodes.name: Save User/PM Message
nodes.notes:
💾 SAVE TO AIRTABLE

Stores user message or PM requirements.

type: 'user' or 'pm'
role: 'user' or 'system'

This creates audit trail.

nodes.name: Retrieve Conversation History
nodes.notes:
📜 GET HISTORY

Retrieves last 20 messages for this chat_id.

Filters by: chat_id
Sorts by: created_at (oldest first)
Limit: 20 messages

This gives AI full context.

nodes.name: Format History for AI
nodes.notes:
🔄 FORMAT CONTEXT

Converts Airtable records to AI-friendly format.

Creates:
- messages array for AI
- context summary
- version tracking
- original requirements

AI now has full conversation history!

nodes.name: AI UX Designer
nodes.notes:
🤖 AI UX ENGINEER

Now has FULL CONTEXT:
- Original requirements
- All previous iterations
- User feedback history
- HTML from previous versions

Makes smarter design decisions!

nodes.name: OpenAI GPT-4
nodes.notes:
🧠 AI MODEL

GPT-4 Turbo with context

parameters.text:
={{ 'You are an expert UX Engineer with access to the full conversation history.

' + $json.contextSummary + '

INSTRUCTIONS:
' + ($json.inputType === 'chat' ? '1. Review the conversation history above
2. Understand what has been built (see previous HTML versions)
3. Apply the user's latest feedback: "' + $json.userMessage + '"
4. Return the COMPLETE updated HTML inside ```html code block
5. Only change what the user requested, keep everything else the same' : '1. Create a beautiful, modern HTML/CSS design based on requirements
2. Requirements: ' + $json.requirements + '
3. Use Tailwind CSS (CDN available)
4. Make it responsive and accessible
5. Return ONLY the HTML code inside ```html code block') }}

nodes.name: Design Prompt with History
nodes.notes:
📝 CONTEXT-AWARE PROMPT

Includes:
- Full conversation history
- Original requirements
- Previous HTML versions
- Latest user request

AI understands EXACTLY what to do!

nodes.name: Extract & Format HTML
nodes.notes:
🔍 HTML EXTRACTOR

Extracts HTML + formats.
Adds version number to watermark.

nodes.name: Save AI Response
nodes.notes:
💾 SAVE AI DESIGN

Stores:
- AI response text
- Generated HTML
- Design version
- Timestamp

Complete audit trail!

nodes.name: Return HTML Preview
nodes.notes:
🖥️ LIVE PREVIEW

Returns HTML with:
- Version number
- Chat ID
- Timestamp

Headers include metadata for tracking.
